question: Should this narrower Crestodian provider-setup handoff land independently, or wait for the broader guided CLI onboarding direction in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101880?
rationale: Both PRs address providerless first-run setup, and automation can fix the lint error but cannot choose the permanent onboarding product boundary.

options.title: Fix and review as a narrow handoff
options.body: Repair the lint blocker, then keep this PR scoped to Crestodian's post-bootstrap model-provider prompt while the broader onboarding work proceeds separately.

options.title: Pause behind guided onboarding
options.body: Hold this PR until the broader guided onboarding PR lands or is closed so there is only one providerless setup direction.

recommendation.title: Fix and review as a narrow handoff
recommendation.body: Repair the lint blocker, then keep this PR scoped to Crestodian's post-bootstrap model-provider prompt while the broader onboarding work proceeds separately.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the overlapping guided CLI onboarding PR and are best positioned to decide whether this narrower handoff should land separately.
